description: Vulnerability in the PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Common Objects Brazil product of Oracle PeopleSoft (component: Common Objects).   The supported version that is affected is 9.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via T3, IIOP to compromise PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Common Objects Brazil.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Common Objects Brazil. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.2 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

product.name: PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Common Objects Brazil
